records.text: According to multiple people with direct knowledge, Owens said Tyler Clancy and Shaner Broderick were allegedly best friends, Clancy belonged to Rob Hild's friend group, and Clancy and Hild played lacrosse together at BYU.

records.notes: Owens extends the Clancy inquiry to the earlier Broderick route-retracing branch by alleging, from people she says have direct knowledge, that Clancy and Shaner Broderick are best friends and Clancy shares Rob Hild's BYU lacrosse friend group.
